Remark
Source: topping:page-0082 1. ch7:1.4\group compactness-manifolds Compactness theorems of this type can use only a bound on $\lvert \Rm \rvert $ or even on $\lvert \Ric \rvert $ when a weaker convergence is sought. In the Ricci flow applications here, bounds on $\lvert \nabla ^k\Rm \rvert $ are available from the derivative estimates of Theorem topping-maxpr-first-derivative-estimate.
